entities.summary: The Union of Krewo (1385) joining Lithuania to Poland, Jogaila's baptism (1387) as Władysław II Jagiełło, and the decisive Battle of Grunwald/Žalgiris (15 July 1410) — one of the largest medieval battles — destroying Teutonic military power.
